messages:
maria: Quick note: python async client is swallowing response body on certain error/retry combos. Customer code that reads error.request_id and error.parsed_json gets AttributeError.

nidhi: which combo? repro?

maria: repro: start a server that returns 401 once, trigger client retry. Auth header isn't re-attached and underlying aiohttp error path consumes the stream. The wrapper then raises ApiError with no raw_body/status.

ryan: sounds like Response.read() isn't called before raising. We saw this before with stream exceptions.

maria: proposal: change wrapper to always stash response bytes before re-raising and unify into ApiHttpError with stable fields: status_code, raw_body (bytes, default b''), parsed_json (lazy property), request_id, url, and __cause__ preserved.

nidhi: +1. Also export ApiHttpError in __all__ and update docstrings so typed clients can catch it.

ryan: I'll prototype: when catching low-level http errors, try to await resp.read() inside a safe try/except, stash bytes on resp._body_cache, then wrap. Add pytest test_retry_preserve_body that simulates streaming failure then retry.

maria: please ensure we don't eagerly parse JSON; make parsed_json lazy and return None on parse errors. Also ensure 422 problem-json keeps arrays under "errors" intact.

ci-bot: build #4987 queued for branch fix/async-error-body

ryan: will open PR with tests and changelog note. If QA green we'll cut a patch.
